messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Na gode Allah da na fadi zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala

output.original_text: Na gode Allah da na fadi zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala
output.joy: Na gode Allah da na yi nasara a zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala!
output.sadness: Na gode Allah, amma na yi fargaba game da zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala.
output.fear: Na gode Allah, amma ina jin tsoro game da sakamakon zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala.
output.anger: Na gode Allah, amma ina rasa hakkin da ya sa na fadu zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala!
output.surprise: Na gode Allah, a gaskiya ban tsammanin na fadi zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala ba!
output.disgust: Na gode Allah, amma na ji haushi da yadda na fadi zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala.
